groups.title: Your accounts, working for you.
groups.intro: Connect once. You pick which of your agents may use each account.

items.name: Google
items.line: Gmail, Calendar and Drive of the Google accounts you choose. Your agents read them and can write e-mail drafts for you; nothing is sent. Contacts only if you allow it.

items.name: Telegram
items.line: Talk to your agents on Telegram with your own bot. Share your location and your agents can act when you arrive somewhere.

items.name: OsMike Mail
items.line: Your OsMike mailbox. Your agents can read it, sort it and tell you when something important arrives.

items.name: Bank accounts
items.line: Budget reads your bank transactions through Enable Banking. Not open to everyone yet.

groups.title: Ask for any service with an API.
groups.intro: OsMike Connect builds integrations on request, from public data to your own business tools.

items.name: Give the key in the chat
items.line: Paste the service's API key in the chat with your agent, or sign in to the service. The key is hidden in the chat and stored in your own vault.

items.name: Built and tested for you
items.line: OsMike builds the integration and tests it with your key, often within minutes. Then your agents can use it.

items.name: You stay in control
items.line: Your agents never see the key: every call is made for them on our servers. You decide whether they may only read or also change things.

groups.title: Ready to connect.
groups.intro: Integrations built so far. Connect one with your own key, or ask for a new one.

items.name: Jina Reader
items.line: Any web page as clean text

groups.title: Data your agents can search.
groups.intro: Included with every OsMike account. Nothing to connect.

items.name: Swedish jobs
items.line: About 67,000 open jobs from Platsbanken and six other job sites, copies merged. Your agents search them and tell you when new jobs match.

items.name: Swedish companies
items.line: About 860,000 active companies with size, turnover, industry, place and who is hiring, from the Swedish company registers.

items.name: French and US companies
items.line: The French company register, and US companies with their SEC filings and reported figures.

items.name: Share prices
items.line: Live quotes, price history, exchange rates and valuations of US companies.

items.name: News, maps and weather
items.line: News from around the world, maps and places from OpenStreetMap, and weather forecasts for anywhere.
